what_happened: The current `athena land` refuses every pull request because its pr_commits check requires an Athena-Job trailer on each commit. The operator landed verified job 20261024-114125-7z2t using an `athena land --pr` built from the older commit 017e7a9, which is the land before 29fdd4c. The merge still went through land's checks and head guard, but it wrote no records-branch records. The fix is being built as job 20261024-140624-ewbs.
cause: The landing history check changed (29fdd4c) and was accepted without being run against a realistic pull request branch. Real branches contain commits with no Athena-Job trailer, such as records-only, owner-path and intervention commits. Nothing replays the new land against typical branch shapes before it becomes the installed land. There is also no sanctioned fallback for when land itself is broken, so the operator has to build an old land by hand. That fallback leaves no records.
prevention: Add a required test or CI gate for any change to land or pr_commits. It would run the check against fixture branches that include job commits, records-only commits, owner-path commits and intervention commits, and it would fail if any valid branch is refused. Separately, add an `athena land` escape path that logs a declared intervention and writes the records, so the operator does not need an old build.
proposed_request: Make `athena land` accept pull requests whose branches contain commits without an Athena-Job trailer, namely records-only, owner-path and intervention commits, while still refusing unexplained commits. Add a regression test that runs the pr_commits check against a fixture branch containing each of those commit kinds plus ordinary job commits. The test must fail on the current behavior and pass after the fix. Also add a check that any change to land code must pass this fixture test before it can land. Finally, record the earlier hand landing of job 20261024-114125-7z2t, which wrote no records-branch records, as a declared intervention.
